ModuleDescription: PICO eye and face tracking for VRCFaceTracking, receiving data from PicoFacialBridge, PICO Connect, Streaming Assistant, or PicoFacialDataDaemon. Supports independent per-eye gaze, mode-specific adaptive gaze smoothing, fixed eyelid sources, and configurable expression processing.
UsageInstructions: Disable older PICO tracking modules, install this module, and restart VRCFaceTracking 5.4.5. Native source-clock gaze smoothing is enabled by default: normal mode uses 100/4 Hz, Beta 1 and Blink 0.30/0.60; dual uses 250/4 Hz, Beta 8 and Openness 0.80/0.45. Eyelids use only Blink in normal mode or native Openness in confirmed enhanced mode, holding the last value when unavailable. EyeWide is amplified 2x; other expression corrections are off. Explicit settings in UnifiedPicoModule.json take precedence. See the README for configuration and validation details.
